title: ALINA cinematic scene layer
goal: Install a real capability-driven cinematic scene adapter without making WebGL a product dependency.
why: M1.5 now exposes honest missing-3D capability. M1.6 must satisfy that capability when the browser can actually run the cinematic adapter and degrade safely otherwise.
constraints: WebGL is an adapter, not the application
domain and Agent Factory state must not live in WebGL objects
reduced motion may suppress animation without changing semantic state
3d capability can only be advertised when the adapter successfully initializes
deliverables: WebGL capability handshake with Avatar Surface
acceptanceCriteria: actual WebGL initialization controls 3d capability truthfully
avatar hologram stops reporting missing 3d only when WebGL adapter is active
testContract: Playwright cinematic capability and fallback proof
